boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Claremont McKenna College
boards.description: Discover the essential late-night food rituals and social hubs that define the student experience at Claremont McKenna College, from on-campus snacks to iconic Route 66 donut runs.

cards.title: Midnight Snack at Collins
cards.subtitle: The Heart of CMC Late Night
cards.notes: Visit Monday through Thursday from 10:30 PM to 11:30 PM for the quintessential CMC late-night social ritual featuring comfort foods like corn dogs and ice cream.
cards.short_summary: The primary on-campus late-night dining tradition at CMC, offering a communal space for students to recharge during study sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: Collins Dining Hall offers a 'Midnight Snack' Monday through Thursday from 10:30 p.m. to 11:30 p.m. for CMC students.
cards.source_title: Dining | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Open 10:30 PM - 11:30 PM Mon-Thu for students with meal plans.

cards.title: Late Night at The Hub
cards.subtitle: Emett Student Center
cards.notes: Head to the Emett Student Center for late-night grill orders; it stays open until 1:00 AM on Fridays and Saturdays for weekend socializers.
cards.short_summary: A central campus eatery providing quick meal options and a social lounge environment late into the evening.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hub Grill is open until 1:00 a.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.source_title: Dining | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:00 AM on Friday and Saturday nights.

cards.title: Jay's Place Pizza Run
cards.subtitle: Harvey Mudd College
cards.notes: Walk over to Harvey Mudd for late-night pizza and sandwiches; it's a favorite 5C destination open until 1:00 AM or 2:00 AM.
cards.short_summary: A popular late-night lounge at Harvey Mudd College frequented by students from all Claremont Colleges for pizza and snacks.
cards.evidence_claim: Jay's Place is open Sunday-Thursday 8 p.m.–1 a.m. and Friday–Saturday 8:30 p.m.–2 a.m.
cards.source_title: Dining Services | Harvey Mudd College
cards.access_notes: Open until 1 AM Sun-Thu and 2 AM Fri-Sat.

cards.title: 24-Hour Donut Run
cards.subtitle: Historic Route 66
cards.notes: Drive to Glendora for world-famous strawberry donuts; this iconic Route 66 spot is open 24/7 for late-night sugar cravings.
cards.short_summary: A legendary 24-hour donut shop in nearby Glendora, famous for its seasonal fresh fruit-stuffed donuts.
cards.evidence_claim: The original Donut Man location in Glendora is open 24 hours, 7 days a week.
cards.source_title: History | The Donut Man
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7; expect lines during peak seasonal fruit periods.

cards.title: The Coop Fountain
cards.subtitle: Pomona College
cards.notes: Visit Pomona's Smith Campus Center for late-night burgers and milkshakes; it's a staple for 5C students seeking a diner vibe.
cards.short_summary: A casual eatery at Pomona College known for its extended hours and classic American grill menu.
cards.evidence_claim: The Coop Fountain is Pomona's meal facility with extended hours to accommodate the late-night crowd.
cards.source_title: Dining - The Claremont Colleges
cards.access_notes: Check seasonal hours for specific late-night closing times.

cards.title: In-N-Out Burger Run
cards.subtitle: Indian Hill Blvd
cards.notes: Drive to the nearby Pomona location for a Double-Double; it's open until 1:00 AM or 1:30 AM for a classic SoCal late-night meal.
cards.short_summary: The closest In-N-Out location to campus, serving as a frequent destination for students with cars late at night.
cards.evidence_claim: The In-N-Out at 1851 Indian Hill Blvd is open until 1:00 a.m. Sun-Thu and 1:30 a.m. Fri-Sat.
cards.source_title: Pomona, CA, 1851 Indian Hill Blvd. - In-N-Out Burger
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:00 AM (Sun-Thu) and 1:30 AM (Fri-Sat).

cards.title: Shakedown Burritos
cards.subtitle: Pitzer College
cards.notes: Walk to Pitzer for late-night burritos and a relaxed atmosphere; it's a popular spot for students to hang out after dark.
cards.short_summary: A student-run cafe at Pitzer College known for its late-night hours and popular burrito options.
cards.evidence_claim: Shakedown at Pitzer is open late into the evening and serves burritos.
cards.source_title: My Top 5 Cafes and Eateries in Claremont - Scripps College
cards.access_notes: Typically open late; check current semester schedule for exact closing.

cards.title: Eureka! Late Night
cards.subtitle: Claremont Village
cards.notes: Visit the Village for 'Hoppy Hour' food deals starting at 9:00 PM; it's a common off-campus spot for late-night burgers.
cards.short_summary: An upscale burger restaurant in Claremont Village offering a late-night happy hour menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Eureka! Claremont offers a late-night happy hour from 9 p.m. to close daily.
cards.source_title: Claremont | Eureka! Restaurants
cards.access_notes: Late-night menu available from 9:00 PM until closing.

cards.title: 24/7 Cooking at Janie's
cards.subtitle: Valach Hall
cards.notes: Utilize this 24/7 communal kitchen in Valach Hall to cook your own late-night meals or bake cookies during finals week.
cards.short_summary: A fully equipped kitchen available 24/7 for CMC students to prepare their own food on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Janie's Kitchen, located in Valach Hall, is available to CMC students 24/7.
cards.source_title: Places to Meet | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Accessible 24/7 for CMC students.

cards.title: Late Night Fire Pit
cards.subtitle: South of Beckett Hall
cards.notes: Gather at the fire pit south of Beckett Hall for 24/7 social time; it's a prime spot for late-night conversations under the stars.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor social space on the CMC campus available at all hours for student gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Beckett Fire Pit is available for students to meet and socialize 24/7.
cards.source_title: Places to Meet | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for student use.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the functional study nooks, social hubs, and late-night spots that define daily life at Claremont McKenna College beyond the standard admission route.

cards.title: The Living Room (The Kube)
cards.subtitle: Kravis Center
cards.notes: Study in this all-glass pavilion suspended over a reflecting pool. It offers panoramic campus views and a quiet atmosphere for reading between classes.
cards.short_summary: An iconic glass-walled study pavilion at the Kravis Center known for its quiet environment and scenic views.
cards.evidence_claim: The Living Room (aka the 'Kube') is an all-glass pavilion that floats on a reflecting pool and is available to the college community.
cards.source_title: Kravis Center | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Open to the CMC community; swipe access is typically required after business hours.

cards.title: The Hub Grill
cards.subtitle: Emett Student Center
cards.notes: Grab a quick meal or late-night snack at this central social hub. It serves as a primary gathering spot for students to refuel and socialize.
cards.short_summary: A central campus eatery and social space offering quick meals and late-night dining options.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hub Grill in the Emett Student Center offers quick meal options and has late-night hours, including dinner until 1:00 am on Fridays.
cards.source_title: Dining | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Open late on weeknights; Friday dinner service extends until 1:00 am.

cards.title: Afternoon Tea at the Ath
cards.subtitle: Marian Miner Cook Athenaeum
cards.notes: Enjoy free tea, coffee, and snacks like chocolate-covered strawberries every weekday afternoon. It is a refined space for casual conversation.
cards.short_summary: A daily afternoon tradition offering light refreshments and a space for community dialogue.
cards.evidence_claim: Athenaeum Tea is offered Monday-Friday from 3:00 p.m. – 4:30 p.m., serving light bites, coffee, and tea to students and faculty.
cards.source_title: Athenaeum FAQs | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Available to students and faculty during weekday afternoon hours.

cards.title: Roberts Pavilion Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Sixth Street
cards.notes: Utilize the state-of-the-art gym and recreational facilities. Students must complete a waiver for card-access entry to this LEED Gold-certified center.
cards.short_summary: The primary athletic and recreation facility for CMC, featuring a modern fitness center and arena.
cards.evidence_claim: Roberts Pavilion is open for recreational use by CMC students and requires a scannable college I.D. card for entry.
cards.source_title: Frequently asked questions about Roberts Pavilion | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Open daily; Monday-Friday 6 a.m. – 11 p.m. with student ID access.

cards.title: CARE Center Lounge
cards.subtitle: Heggblade Center
cards.notes: Find a comfortable spot for dialogue or quiet study in this resource center. It is designed to support civility and inclusive community engagement.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated space for resources, dialogue, and study located within the Heggblade Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The CARE Center (Civility, Access, Resources, and Expression) is open Sunday through Friday until midnight for student use.
cards.source_title: Places to Meet | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight most nights; accessible to all CMC students.

cards.title: Janie's Kitchen
cards.subtitle: Valach Hall
cards.notes: Exercise your culinary skills in this 24/7 student kitchen. It is a popular spot for baking cookies during finals or cooking group dinners.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 communal kitchen available for CMC students to cook and gather.
cards.evidence_claim: Housed in Valach Hall, Janie's Kitchen is available 24/7 for CMC students to exercise their culinary skills.
cards.source_title: Places to Meet | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Accessible 24/7 to CMC students via card swipe.

cards.title: Beckett Fire Pit
cards.subtitle: South of Beckett Hall
cards.notes: Gather with friends at this outdoor social spot. It is available 24/7 for students to meet and socialize in a relaxed, open-air setting.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor fire pit area used by students for late-night socializing and gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Beckett Fire Pit is located just south of Beckett Hall and is available 24/7 for students to meet and socialize.
cards.source_title: Places to Meet | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Available 24/7; students should follow posted operating instructions.

cards.title: Crocker Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Bauer North
cards.notes: Access this quiet academic space for focused study. It is a traditional reading room environment located within the Bauer Center complex.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated quiet reading and study room located in the Bauer North building.
cards.evidence_claim: Student cards unlock the Crocker reading room in Bauer North for academic use.
cards.source_title: Frequently Asked Questions | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Accessible via student ID card; hours vary by academic schedule.

cards.title: Midnight Snack at Collins
cards.subtitle: Collins Hall
cards.notes: Refuel during late-night study sessions with a quick pick-me-up. This weeknight tradition provides snacks for students outside of regular meal hours.
cards.short_summary: A late-night snack service for students held at the main dining hall on weeknights.
cards.evidence_claim: Midnight Snack is available Monday-Thursday from 10:30 p.m. – 11:30 p.m. in Collins Hall for CMC students.
cards.source_title: Dining | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Offered Monday through Thursday from 10:30 p.m. to 11:30 p.m.

cards.title: The Cave Music Room
cards.subtitle: Marks Hall Basement
cards.notes: Practice your instrument or perform in this dedicated basement space. It is a reservable venue for student musicians, poets, and singers.
cards.short_summary: A basement performance and practice space for student artists and musicians.
cards.evidence_claim: The Marks Music Room (The Cave) is located in the basement of Marks Hall and is a place for student performers to practice.
cards.source_title: Places to Meet | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Reserve-only space; open Sunday-Thursday until midnight and Friday-Saturday until 1 a.m.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Discover free social spaces and activities at Claremont McKenna College, from iconic glass lounges to traditional birthday celebrations and late-night snacks.

cards.title: Study in the Glass Kube
cards.subtitle: Kravis Center
cards.notes: Relax in this iconic all-glass student lounge floating on a granite reflecting pool. It is a signature spot for collaborative study and mountain views.
cards.short_summary: An iconic glass-enclosed student lounge at the Kravis Center offering 360-degree campus views.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kravis Center's most photographed feature is its all glass Living Room (aka the “Kube”) that floats on a Mesabi black granite reflecting pool and is always available to the entire College community.
cards.source_title: Kravis Center | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Accessible to the CMC community; student ID card required for entry to the interior space.

cards.title: Afternoon Tea and Treats
cards.subtitle: Marian Miner Cook Athenaeum
cards.notes: Enjoy complimentary tea, coffee, and light bites like chocolate-covered strawberries every weekday afternoon. No registration is required for this social hour.
cards.short_summary: A daily afternoon social hour providing free refreshments to the CMC community.
cards.evidence_claim: Offered Monday-Friday from 3:00 p.m. – 4:30 p.m., the Athenaeum serves light bites, coffee and tea to students, faculty and guests.
cards.source_title: Places to Meet | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Open Monday through Friday, 3:00 PM to 4:30 PM during the academic year.

cards.title: Watch a Birthday Ponding
cards.subtitle: Central Campus
cards.notes: Visit the central fountains where students carry out the 'ponding' tradition, tossing friends into the water on their birthdays.
cards.short_summary: The central campus plaza and fountain known for the traditional birthday 'ponding' ritual.
cards.evidence_claim: The majority of Claremont McKenna students visit Flamson Plaza daily... sitting quietly next to its fountains to study or ponding fellow students in the water on their birthdays.
cards.source_title: Flamson Plaza - The Claremont McKenna College Digital Events Calendar
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor plaza located between The Hub and the Athenaeum.

cards.title: Work Out at Roberts Pavilion
cards.subtitle: Athletic Center
cards.notes: Access state-of-the-art fitness equipment and group classes. Entry is free for CMC students with a valid ID and a completed waiver.
cards.short_summary: A LEED Gold-certified fitness and events center available for student recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: Roberts Pavilion is open for recreational use by Claremont McKenna, Harvey Mudd, and Scripps Students... Free for CMC, Harvey Mudd, and Scripps students.
cards.source_title: Roberts Pavilion - Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Requires valid student ID and a signed waiver submitted three days prior to first use.

cards.title: Grab a Midnight Snack
cards.subtitle: Collins Hall
cards.notes: Stop by Collins Hall for a late-night pick-me-up. This free snack service runs four nights a week for students taking a study break.
cards.short_summary: A late-night complimentary snack service for students at Collins Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Available Monday-Thursday from 10:30 p.m. – 11:30 p.m., Midnight Snack is offered in Collins Hall to CMC students.
cards.source_title: Places to Meet | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Offered Monday through Thursday, 10:30 PM to 11:30 PM.

cards.title: Socialize by the Fire Pit
cards.subtitle: South of Beckett Hall
cards.notes: Gather with friends at this outdoor fire pit available 24/7. It is a popular spot for evening socializing and informal meetings.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor fire pit located near Beckett Hall available for student use at any time.
cards.evidence_claim: The Beckett Fire Pit is located just south of Beckett Hall and is available for students to meet and socialize... Hours: 24/7.
cards.source_title: Places to Meet | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Available 24/7 for student use; follow posted operating instructions.

cards.title: Hang Out at The Hub
cards.subtitle: Emmett Student Center
cards.notes: Use the pool tables, watch satellite TV, or relax in comfortable seating. This central student center is the heart of social life on campus.
cards.short_summary: A student social center featuring recreational games, TVs, and lounge seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hub houses pool tables, flat-screen satellite TVs, comfortable seating... and serves as a gathering spot.
cards.source_title: SELF-GUIDED TOUR - Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Open daily; check website for specific Hub Grill and Store hours.

cards.title: Relax on Parents Field
cards.subtitle: South Quad
cards.notes: Join students sunbathing or playing intramural sports on this large green space. It offers great views of the San Gabriel Mountains.
cards.short_summary: A large athletic and recreational field used for intramural sports and student relaxation.
cards.evidence_claim: Parents Field is the hub of intramural activities on campus... Students lie out on Parents Field on sunny afternoons.
cards.source_title: Parents Field - The Claremont McKenna College Digital Events Calendar
cards.access_notes: Open outdoor space; used for scheduled intramural games and general recreation.

cards.title: Connect at the CARE Center
cards.subtitle: Heggblade Center
cards.notes: Visit this space for dialogue and community building. It offers a comfortable environment for difficult conversations and student engagement.
cards.short_summary: A center focused on civility, access, and resources, providing a space for student dialogue.
cards.evidence_claim: The CARE Center (Civility, Access, Resources, and Expression) engages the community to develop the skills needed to have difficult conversations... Hours: Sunday through Friday, 9 a.m. to midnight.
cards.source_title: CARE Center - Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Open Sunday-Friday 9 AM to Midnight, Saturday 10 AM to 6 PM.

cards.title: Join a Free Outdoor Trip
cards.subtitle: ASCMC Program
cards.notes: Sign up for free weekly excursions including hiking, rock climbing, and backpacking. Equipment and transportation are provided at no cost to students.
cards.short_summary: A student-run program offering free weekly outdoor adventures and gear for CMC students.
cards.evidence_claim: CMC Outdoor Initiative is committed to providing CMC free, weekly trips into the outdoors. From hiking to backpacking to rock climbing, OI's trained leaders provide fun and free trips.
cards.source_title: Outdoor Initiative - ASCMC
cards.access_notes: Trips are announced via email list; applications for leaders open each semester.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Discover the most effective study environments at CMC, from the iconic glass-walled Living Room to the quiet terraces of the new Robert Day Sciences Center.

cards.title: The Living Room (The Kube)
cards.subtitle: Kravis Center
cards.notes: Study inside this all-glass pavilion floating on a granite reflecting pool. It is centrally located and available to the entire college community for collaborative work.
cards.short_summary: An iconic glass-walled study pavilion at the Kravis Center known for its transparent design and central campus location.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kravis Center's most photographed feature is its all glass Living Room (aka the 'Kube') that floats on a Mesabi black granite reflecting pool and is always available to the entire College community.
cards.source_title: Kravis Center | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Open to the CMC community; features a transparent glass structure with seating over a reflecting pool.

cards.title: Honnold/Mudd Library Top Floor
cards.subtitle: The Claremont Colleges Library
cards.notes: Head to the highest levels for the quietest atmosphere. The library provides individual nooks and reservable group rooms equipped with whiteboards and markers.
cards.short_summary: The main research library for the 5Cs, offering increasingly quiet zones on higher floors and private group study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: The higher you go up in levels, the quieter it gets. There's plenty of private rooms you can rent out for a period of time... These rooms come with white boards and markers!
cards.source_title: The Rundown on Honnold Mudd Library | Scripps College
cards.access_notes: Tap or swipe your ID card to access library spaces. Reservable rooms are available for 1-4 hours.

cards.title: Robert Day Sciences Center Terraces
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Rooftop Study Areas
cards.notes: Utilize one of the eight outdoor rooftop terraces for 360-degree views of the mountains and campus. These spaces are designed specifically for outdoor study and meetings.
cards.short_summary: New multifunctional rooftop terraces at the Robert Day Sciences Center providing scenic outdoor study environments.
cards.evidence_claim: Eight outdoor rooftop terraces... offer sweeping 360-degree views... These multifunctional spaces... are designed to be used as outdoor classrooms, study areas, or places to meet.
cards.source_title: Claremont McKenna College Robert Day Sciences Center / BIG
cards.access_notes: Outdoor terraces accessible to students for study and informal meetings.

cards.title: Athenaeum Afternoon Tea
cards.subtitle: Monday-Friday, 3:00-4:30 p.m.
cards.notes: Visit during afternoon tea for a stimulating setting to study or discuss ideas. Enjoy coffee, tea, and light bites like chocolate-covered strawberries while you work.
cards.short_summary: A community hub offering a formal yet intimate environment for study and dialogue during daily tea service.
cards.evidence_claim: Offered Monday-Friday from 3:00 p.m. – 4:30 p.m., the Athenaeum serves light bites, coffee and tea to students, faculty and guests.
cards.source_title: Places to Meet | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday for tea service; business casual attire is generally expected for formal programs.

cards.title: Roberts Pavilion Lobby Lounge
cards.subtitle: Fitness and Events Center
cards.notes: Enter through the vaulted glass lobby to find a social and study lounge. It is a modern space with mountain views, ideal for light work before or after a workout.
cards.short_summary: A bright, modern lounge located in the main lobby of the Roberts Pavilion athletic center.
cards.evidence_claim: After entering through a vaulted glass lobby with a social/study lounge... a myriad of recreational spaces will be accessible.
cards.source_title: Roberts Pavilion | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Accessible during pavilion hours; features lounge seating in a high-ceilinged glass lobby.

cards.title: Crocker Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Bauer North
cards.notes: Access this dedicated reading room in Bauer North using your student ID. It provides a traditional, quiet academic environment for focused reading and writing.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, student-accessible reading room located within the Bauer North academic building.
cards.evidence_claim: Student cards will unlock... Bauer North (and Crocker reading room).
cards.source_title: Frequently Asked Questions | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Requires student ID card for entry; located in Bauer North.

cards.title: The CARE Center
cards.subtitle: Heggblade Center
cards.notes: Study in a space dedicated to civility and dialogue. It offers a comfortable environment for students to work and engage in effective dialogue.
cards.short_summary: A resource center in Heggblade providing a supportive environment for study and community engagement.
cards.evidence_claim: The CARE Center... engages the community... Hours: Sunday through Friday, 9 a.m. to midnight and Saturday, 10 a.m. to 6 p.m.
cards.source_title: Places to Meet | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Open late until midnight most nights; accessible via student ID card.

cards.title: Kravis Second Floor Study Lounges
cards.subtitle: Kravis Center
cards.notes: Use your student ID to access these study lounges on the second floor of the Kravis Center. They offer a quieter alternative to the main 'Living Room' area.
cards.short_summary: Restricted-access study lounges on the second floor of the Kravis Center for CMC students.
cards.evidence_claim: Student cards will unlock... Kravis second floor study lounges.
cards.source_title: Frequently Asked Questions | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Requires student ID card for access to the second-floor academic spaces.

cards.title: Soll Center Interview Rooms
cards.subtitle: Bauer Center
cards.notes: Reserve these private rooms for virtual interviews or focused career-related study. They provide a professional and quiet environment away from common areas.
cards.short_summary: Private, reservable rooms in the Soll Center intended for interviews and career development tasks.
cards.evidence_claim: The Soll Center for Student Opportunity offers... interview rooms for student use... and room reservations.
cards.source_title: In-Semester Funding & Room Reservations | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Rooms must be reserved in advance through the Soll Center for Student Opportunity.

cards.title: The Hub Patio
cards.subtitle: Emett Student Center
cards.notes: Study outdoors under the umbrellas at the Hub Patio. It offers a central location with shade and ambient noise, suitable for casual work between classes.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor shaded patio area centrally located near the Emett Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hub patio is a fairly good place to study. Centrally located for CMCers, the Hub patio boasts shade provided by umbrellas.
cards.source_title: Best Places to Study at the 5Cs - The Claremont Independent
cards.access_notes: Open outdoor area with umbrella-shaded tables; accessible 24/7.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Explore the walkable corridors of the Claremont Village and surrounding districts where CMC students study, shop, and gather just steps from the 7Cs consortium.

cards.title: The Village Heart
cards.subtitle: Yale Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Walk this central Village block to find student favorites like 42nd Street Bagel Cafe and Bert & Rocky's Cream Co. for quick off-campus bites.
cards.short_summary: A primary commercial artery in the Claremont Village featuring numerous cafes and local boutiques.
cards.evidence_claim: Yale Avenue is a central part of the Claremont Village with businesses like 42nd Street Bagel Cafe and Bert & Rocky's Cream Co.
cards.source_title: SHOP & DINE - Claremont Village Marketing Group
cards.access_notes: Public street with metered and free street parking available throughout the Village.

cards.title: Artisan Hub on First
cards.subtitle: West First Street
cards.notes: Visit this repurposed historic citrus facility to browse the Claremont Forum Bookshop or grab a coffee at Augie's in a high-ceilinged industrial space.
cards.short_summary: A historic industrial building converted into a multi-use center for dining, retail, and community events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Claremont Packing House is located at 532 W 1st St and houses the Claremont Forum Bookshop and Augie's Coffee.
cards.source_title: Home | Claremont Packing House
cards.access_notes: Open daily; the building features public seating areas and restrooms.

cards.title: Modern Plaza Hangout
cards.subtitle: Indian Hill Boulevard
cards.notes: Relax by the public fountain or catch a movie at the Regency Theatre in this newer expansion of the historic downtown district.
cards.short_summary: A contemporary mixed-use plaza featuring a cinema, hotel, and outdoor public seating areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Village Square is a destination in the center of the Claremont Village featuring a public plaza and interactive fountain.
cards.source_title: Claremont Village Square | Shop Dine Relax
cards.access_notes: The public plaza is accessible 24/7; individual business hours vary.

cards.title: Village Green Space
cards.subtitle: Bonita Avenue & Harvard Avenue
cards.notes: Use this pocket park for a quiet outdoor study session or a picnic lunch between the Village and the northern residential blocks.
cards.short_summary: A small community park located at a key intersection within the Claremont Village.
cards.evidence_claim: Shelton Park is a pocket park located at Harvard Ave and Bonita Ave in the Claremont Village.
cards.source_title: Parks | City of Claremont, CA
cards.access_notes: Public city park open from dawn until dusk.

cards.title: Courtyard Dining
cards.subtitle: Harvard Avenue
cards.notes: Find a table in the hidden courtyard of this commercial block to enjoy a meal from Bardot or browse the local boutiques.
cards.short_summary: A commercial courtyard complex on Harvard Avenue known for its dining and specialty shops.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvard Square on Harvard Avenue houses businesses like Bardot and Dani California Boutique.
cards.source_title: SHOP & DINE - Claremont Village Marketing Group
cards.access_notes: The courtyard is open to the public during business hours.

cards.title: Off-Campus Living Hub
cards.subtitle: First Street & Mills Avenue
cards.notes: Walk through this residential block adjacent to campus, a primary housing area for upperclassmen choosing to live off-campus.
cards.short_summary: A major apartment complex and residential area popular with Claremont Colleges students.
cards.evidence_claim: College Park is an apartment community adjacent to the Claremont Colleges, popular for off-campus housing.
cards.source_title: Off-Campus Housing | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Residential area; public sidewalks allow for walking access to campus.

cards.title: Gateway to LA
cards.subtitle: First Street Corridor
cards.notes: Use this transit block to catch the San Bernardino Line for weekend trips to Los Angeles or to visit the nearby Claremont Museum of Art.
cards.short_summary: The city's primary transit hub connecting Claremont to the greater Los Angeles area.
cards.evidence_claim: The Claremont Metrolink station is located in the Village and provides access to the San Bernardino Line.
cards.source_title: Claremont Station | Metrolink
cards.access_notes: Station platform is accessible; train fares apply for travel.

cards.title: The Coffee Corridor
cards.subtitle: West Bonita Avenue
cards.notes: Study at Philz Coffee or grab a crepe at Crepes of Wrath on this busy street that marks the northern edge of the Village.
cards.short_summary: A major east-west street featuring several popular student cafes and eateries.
cards.evidence_claim: Philz Coffee and Crepes of Wrath are located on West Bonita Avenue in the Claremont Village.
cards.source_title: Philz Coffee opens location in Claremont Village - The Student Life
cards.access_notes: Public street with high pedestrian traffic near the colleges.

cards.title: Musical Landmark
cards.subtitle: Yale Avenue
cards.notes: Explore this historic shop and museum to see rare instruments or attend a community open mic night in a legendary local venue.
cards.short_summary: A world-renowned musical instrument store and museum owned by the family of Ben Harper.
cards.evidence_claim: The Folk Music Center is a beloved spot in the Village where visitors can see and try out musical instruments.
cards.source_title: Folk Music Center & Museum
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday through Saturday; the museum portion is free to browse.

cards.title: Weekend Community Hub
cards.subtitle: Harvard Avenue
cards.notes: Visit Harvard Avenue on Sunday mornings to browse local produce and handmade goods at this long-running community market.
cards.short_summary: A weekly outdoor market featuring local farmers, artisans, and food vendors.
cards.evidence_claim: The Claremont Farmers & Artisans Market is held every Sunday on Harvard Avenue.
cards.source_title: Claremont Farmers & Artisans Market
cards.access_notes: Held Sundays from 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM, rain or shine.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Discover the unique rituals and long-standing traditions that define the student experience at Claremont McKenna College, from birthday pondings to Renaissance feasts.

cards.title: Birthday Ponding
cards.subtitle: A Refreshing Birthday Surprise
cards.notes: Friends carry the birthday student to one of the campus fountains for a surprise dunking. It is a rite of passage for every CMCer during their four years.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing CMC tradition where students are thrown into campus fountains on their birthdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Ponding is a well-documented tradition at Claremont McKenna College where students are dunked in fountains on their birthdays.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions - Old and New · CMC Campus Stories
cards.access_notes: Occurs spontaneously at various campus fountains throughout the academic year.

cards.title: Ath Tea
cards.subtitle: Afternoon Treats and Conversation
cards.notes: Gather at the 'Ath' every afternoon for free tea and famous Rice Krispie treats. It is a daily social hub for students and faculty to mingle before evening lectures.
cards.short_summary: A daily afternoon tea service at the Marian Miner Cook Athenaeum featuring snacks and social interaction.
cards.evidence_claim: Athenaeum Tea, or 'Ath Tea,' is one of CMC's longest-standing traditions, occurring daily at the Marian Miner Cook Athenaeum.
cards.source_title: Athenaeum | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Open to the CMC community Monday through Friday afternoons during the semester.

cards.title: Madrigal Feast
cards.subtitle: A Renaissance Holiday Celebration
cards.notes: Experience a multi-course medieval dinner complete with court jesters and choral performances. This annual December event transforms the Ath into a royal hall.
cards.short_summary: An annual Renaissance-themed holiday dinner theater event held at the Athenaeum.
cards.evidence_claim: The Madrigal Feast is an annual holiday tradition at CMC featuring medieval food, music, and entertainment at the Athenaeum.
cards.source_title: It's Time Again For Madrigal Feast - Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Ticketed event held over several nights in early December; student pricing available.

cards.title: Monte Carlo Night
cards.subtitle: High Stakes and Formal Attire
cards.notes: Dress up for CMC's longest-running social event featuring casino games and dancing. This fall tradition has been a campus staple since 1949.
cards.short_summary: A formal casino-themed night that is the longest-running social tradition at CMC.
cards.evidence_claim: Monte Carlo Night began in 1949 and remains a signature annual casino-themed social event at CMC.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions - Old and New · CMC Campus Stories
cards.access_notes: Typically held in the fall semester; open to all CMC students.

cards.title: 6:01 Party
cards.subtitle: The Start of the Social Year
cards.notes: Celebrate the end of the first week of classes with this massive outdoor gathering on Green Beach. It traditionally marks the conclusion of 'dry week' for the campus.
cards.short_summary: An annual party on Green Beach that marks the end of the first week of the academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: The 6:01 party is a traditional event held on Green Beach to celebrate the end of the first week of classes.
cards.source_title: Surviving 6:01 - The Claremont Independent
cards.access_notes: Held on the first Saturday evening of the fall semester on Green Beach.

cards.title: Pirate Party
cards.subtitle: A Swashbuckling Spring Tradition
cards.notes: Don your best eye patch for this massive spring event featuring pirate-themed decor and music. It is one of the most anticipated social gatherings of the year.
cards.short_summary: A large-scale, pirate-themed social event held annually in the spring.
cards.evidence_claim: Pirate Party is a signature annual tradition at CMC, typically held in the spring and known for its high attendance.
cards.source_title: Despite Controversy, CMC Pirate Party to be 5C Event - The Student Life
cards.access_notes: Annual spring event; access policies for non-CMC students vary by year.

cards.title: Thursday Night Club (TNC)
cards.subtitle: The Weekly Social Anchor
cards.notes: Join the weekly themed party hosted by different dorms every Thursday night. It is the primary mid-week social outlet for the CMC community.
cards.short_summary: A weekly themed social event hosted by CMC dorms every Thursday night.
cards.evidence_claim: Thursday Night Club (TNC) is a weekly party tradition at CMC, typically hosted by a different dorm each week.
cards.source_title: Claremont McKenna College - CMC 101 Guide
cards.access_notes: Occurs every Thursday night during the academic year at rotating campus locations.

cards.title: Wedding Party
cards.subtitle: A Mock Nuptial Celebration
cards.notes: Attend this elaborate mock wedding ceremony where students dress in formal bridal party attire. It is a satirical and highly produced social event.
cards.short_summary: A large-scale mock wedding social event that is a staple of the CMC social calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wedding Party is a recognized social tradition at CMC involving a mock wedding ceremony and celebration.
cards.source_title: OPINION: CMC students can change party culture - The Student Life
cards.access_notes: Annual themed social event; check ASCMC calendar for dates.

cards.title: The Stag Mascot
cards.subtitle: Symbol of CMC Athletics
cards.notes: Look for the Stag at athletic events and campus celebrations. Adopted in 1957, the mascot represents the joint athletic program with Harvey Mudd College.
cards.short_summary: The official mascot for CMC's men's athletic teams, the Stags.
cards.evidence_claim: The Stag was adopted as the mascot for CMC-HMC athletic teams in 1957.
cards.source_title: How CMS teams became the Stags and Athenas | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Visible at CMS athletic games and major campus events like Family Weekend.

cards.title: Family Weekend Photo Op
cards.subtitle: Memories with the Mascot
cards.notes: Snap a photo with the Stag and Athena mascots during the annual Family Weekend. It is a favorite tradition for visiting families to document their campus visit.
cards.short_summary: A recurring event during Family Weekend where families take photos with campus mascots.
cards.evidence_claim: Family Weekend at CMC includes a scheduled photo op with the Stag and Athena mascots at Roberts Pavilion.
cards.source_title: Family Weekend Schedule - Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Held annually in February; photo ops are typically scheduled at Roberts Pavilion.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Claremont McKenna College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A guide to the essential first-weekend experiences for new CMC students, from orientation traditions to local Claremont staples.

cards.title: Move-In Morning
cards.subtitle: Unload at the Quads
cards.notes: Arrive early to meet your First-Year Guide and unload at North, Mid, or South Quad. Keys are typically distributed starting at 8:00 a.m. on move-in Sunday.
cards.short_summary: The official start of the CMC experience begins with Sunday morning move-in at the residence halls.
cards.evidence_claim: New student move-in for Fall 2026 is scheduled for Sunday, August 23, with keys distributed starting at 8:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Parent and Family Orientation - Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Restricted to students and families during move-in; requires student ID for building access.

cards.title: First Campus Meal
cards.subtitle: Brunch at Collins
cards.notes: Head to Collins for your first meal on the board plan. Weekend brunch runs from 10:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. and is a prime spot to meet fellow new students.
cards.short_summary: Collins Dining Hall serves as the central hub for student meals and weekend brunch gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Collins Dining Hall serves weekend brunch from 10:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. and dinner from 4:30 p.m. to 6:30 p.m.
cards.source_title: Dining | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Open to students with a meal plan; guest rates available for credit card purchase.

cards.title: WOA Trip Kickoff
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Orientation
cards.notes: Prepare for your required WOA trip. These student-led excursions range from beach camping to mountain cabins and are designed for peer bonding.
cards.short_summary: The Welcome Orientation Adventure (WOA) is a mandatory multi-day trip for all incoming first-year students.
cards.evidence_claim: WOA trips are a required part of the orientation experience, with departures typically occurring on the first Sunday or Monday.
cards.source_title: Welcome Orientation Adventure | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Mandatory for all new students; registration via the Orientation Portal is required.

cards.title: The Living Room
cards.subtitle: Kravis Center Glass Kube
cards.notes: Visit the all-glass 'Living Room' at the Kravis Center. It's a signature campus spot for informal meetings and offers views of the San Bernardino Mountains.
cards.short_summary: The Kube is a transparent glass structure in the Kravis Center used as a communal study and meeting space.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kravis Center's glass 'Living Room' (aka the 'Kube') is a favorite destination for students and is always available to the college community.
cards.source_title: Kravis Center | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Open to the college community; accessible 24/7 for students with ID.

cards.title: Afternoon Gym Session
cards.subtitle: Fitness and Events Center
cards.notes: Check out the state-of-the-art fitness center. Bring your student ID to access the weight room, cardio equipment, and basketball courts.
cards.short_summary: Roberts Pavilion is the primary athletic and recreation facility for CMC, Harvey Mudd, and Scripps students.
cards.evidence_claim: Roberts Pavilion is open for recreational use by CMC students; weekend hours are typically 9 a.m.–9 p.m. on Saturdays and 11 a.m.–11 p.m. on Sundays.
cards.source_title: Frequently asked questions about Roberts Pavilion - Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Requires a valid school ID for entry; users must complete a waiver before first use.

cards.title: Village Walk
cards.subtitle: Downtown Claremont
cards.notes: Walk a few blocks west to explore the Village. It's filled with boutiques, thrift stores, and cafes like Some Crust Bakery or Bert & Rocky's.
cards.short_summary: Claremont Village is the historic downtown district adjacent to the colleges, known for its walkable streets and local shops.
cards.evidence_claim: Claremont Village is a walkable college town district with artisan bakeries, vintage stores, and restaurants, located within walking distance of campus.
cards.source_title: WELCOME to CLAREMONT - CALIFORNIA'S BEST COLLEGE TOWN
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible district; most shops open daily until early evening.

cards.title: Village Sweet Treat
cards.subtitle: Ice Cream and Candy
cards.notes: A student favorite for over 30 years. Grab a scoop of homemade ice cream or a chocolate-dipped cone while exploring the downtown area.
cards.short_summary: Bert & Rocky's is a long-standing ice cream and candy shop in Claremont Village popular with students.
cards.evidence_claim: Bert & Rocky's is a staple in the Claremont Village, offering a wide variety of ice cream flavors and chocolate-dipped cones.
cards.source_title: My Favorite Spots in the Claremont Village - Sagehen Stories
cards.access_notes: Open daily; late hours on weekends (typically until 10 or 11 p.m.).

cards.title: Library Orientation
cards.subtitle: The 5C Library
cards.notes: Locate your study spots early. This shared library for the Claremont Colleges offers quiet zones, group rooms, and the Library Cafe.
cards.short_summary: Honnold/Mudd Library is the main library serving the Claremont Colleges consortium.
cards.evidence_claim: The library is open on weekends, with Saturday hours typically 11:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. during the academic year.
cards.source_title: Building Hours - The Claremont Colleges Library
cards.access_notes: Requires student ID for entry; visitors have limited access hours.

cards.title: Late Night at The Hub
cards.subtitle: Emett Student Center
cards.notes: Stop by the Hub for a late-night snack. It's the social center of campus on weekend nights, often serving food until 1:00 or 2:00 a.m.
cards.short_summary: The Hub Grill is a casual campus eatery and social space located in the Emett Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hub Grill offers late-night hours, typically open until 1:00 a.m. on Fridays and 2:00 a.m. on Saturdays.
cards.source_title: Dining | Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Open late for students; accepts Claremont Cash and credit cards.

cards.title: Afternoon Tea Tradition
cards.subtitle: Marian Miner Cook Athenaeum
cards.notes: Experience a CMC staple. Afternoon tea is served weekdays, but the 'Ath' is a place to familiarize yourself with for future speaker events.
cards.short_summary: The Athenaeum (the 'Ath') is CMC's signature venue for shared meals and intellectual discourse.
cards.evidence_claim: The Athenaeum serves tea Monday through Friday from 3:00 p.m. to 4:30 p.m., featuring light bites and their famous chocolate-covered strawberries.
cards.source_title: Athenaeum FAQs - Claremont McKenna College
cards.access_notes: Tea is open to students; evening speaker events require advance registration and professional attire.
